crossRefs.note: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
“Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
I will answer you, and your companions with you.

translations.web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
translations.bsb: I too will answer; yes, I will declare what I know.
translations.kjv: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
translations.asv: I also will answer my part, I also will show mine opinion.
